name: banking77_v4
instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which intent best describes what the customer is asking about? Pick the single most specific matching intent.

criteria.activate_my_card: Customer has received their card and asks how to activate it or has trouble activating it.
criteria.age_limit: How old you must be to open an account or use the service; can children/teenagers have an account.

apple_pay_or_google_pay.meaning: Anything involving Apple Pay, Google Pay, Apple Watch or other phone wallets, INCLUDING topping up / adding money via Apple Pay or Google Pay and top-ups via Apple/Google Pay not working.
examples: How can I top up with Apple Pay?

criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs accept the card, where to find an ATM, whether the card works in ATMs in general (not a specific failed withdrawal).
criteria.automatic_top_up: Auto top-up feature: setting it up, how it works, turning it off, why it triggered.

balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer.meaning: Customer made a bank transfer into this account from their own UK or other bank account (or received one), and the money is not showing / balance not updated / it doesn't seem to be working / wondering if it went okay, even if they also ask how long such a transfer normally takes. Not for ATM/cash transactions shown as 'in progress'.
examples: How long does a transfer from a UK account take? I just made one and it doesn't seem to be working, wondering if everything is okay

criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Customer deposited a cheque or cash but it is not reflected in the balance yet.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Adding a payee/beneficiary fails or is not allowed; cannot add a new recipient.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Customer wants to cancel or reverse a transfer they made (sent to wrong account, changed mind).
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring or expired; how to get a replacement for an expiring card; what happens when card expires.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted; whether merchants/shops/countries accept the card for payment.
criteria.card_arrival: Customer ordered a card and it has NOT arrived yet; tracking a card in the post; card still not received.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes in general; expected delivery time; can delivery be expedited; delivery to a specific country (before/without complaining it is late).
criteria.card_linking: Linking a card to the app/account, re-linking or adding a card found again, linking an existing card in the app.
criteria.card_not_working: The card is generally not working / cannot be used, without saying a specific payment was declined or rejected.
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Customer was charged an unexpected fee on a card payment/purchase.

card_payment_not_recognised.meaning: A card payment/transaction on the statement that the customer does not recognise or did not make.
examples: Why is there an uknown charge showing on my account?

criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: The exchange rate applied to a card PAYMENT/purchase abroad was wrong or worse than expected.
criteria.card_swallowed: ATM kept/swallowed/retained the card; card stuck in machine.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Fee charged for withdrawing cash from an ATM; why was I charged for a cash withdrawal.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal on the account that the customer did not make or does not recognise.
criteria.change_pin: How to change or reset the PIN (not blocked, not forgotten passcode).
criteria.compromised_card: Card details may have been compromised, someone else may be using the card, suspected fraud/skimming, card details leaked (but card not physically lost).
criteria.country_support: Which countries the service/account is available in; can I open an account or use the service from a given country.

declined_card_payment.meaning: A card payment was explicitly declined, rejected or not accepted at a shop, restaurant or online.
examples: My card was not accepted in a shop

criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal was declined/refused.
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer the customer tried to make was declined/rejected/not allowed.

direct_debit_payment_not_recognised.meaning: A direct debit on the account that the customer does not recognise.
examples: i do not know what this charge is for

criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits/restrictions of disposable virtual cards: how many times usable, how many can I create, usage limits.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Change personal details: name, address, email, phone number, account details.
criteria.exchange_charge: Fees/charges for currency exchange; why was I charged for exchanging currency; extra fee on exchange.
criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rate is used, where the rates come from, how rates are determined, current rates.
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange currencies in the app; holding/converting between currencies.

extra_charge_on_statement.meaning: An unexpected extra small charge (e.g. an extra £1 / $1 / €1, possibly pending) appearing on the statement; why is there an extra charge.
examples: Why is it showing that my account has been charged a dollar that is showing as pending?

failed_transfer.meaning: A transfer or large payment (e.g. mortgage or flat purchase payment) failed, gives an error, did not go through, or was returned.
examples: I'm getting an error when trying to make a payment. I want to purchase a flat but my mortgage payment needs to go through. Can you help me?

criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies can be held or exchanged; whether a specific currency is supported for holding/exchange.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get/create a disposable (single-use) virtual card.
criteria.get_physical_card: About the card PIN when receiving the physical card: where to find the PIN, PIN not received, how to get a PIN for the card.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional/spare/extra card for the account, e.g. for a family member.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get a virtual card (not disposable); does the bank offer virtual cards; cost of virtual card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card was lost or stolen; what to do if card is lost; found card after reporting it lost.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone was lost or stolen; losing access to the app because phone is gone.

order_physical_card.meaning: How to get or order a physical (plastic) card, wanting a physical card, ordering a new card, card ordering fees and cost.
examples: How would I go about getting a physical card to use in stores?

criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode/password; how to reset the passcode to log in.

pending_card_payment.meaning: A card payment or purchase is showing as pending, or a payment has not gone through / completed yet (still processing, not declined).
examples: I have a payment that has not gone through yet

pending_cash_withdrawal.meaning: A cash withdrawal is pending / 'transaction in progress'. Includes: the customer didn't receive their money (e.g. from an ATM that didn't work) and the app says the transaction is still in progress.
examples: I didn't receive my money earlier and it says the transaction is still in progress. Can you fix it?

pending_top_up.meaning: A top-up is pending, still processing, or the customer topped up and the funds haven't arrived / it doesn't seem to have completed yet / not sure it went through.
examples: Where are my funds? I topped off my car but it didn't seem to complete.

pending_transfer.meaning: An outgoing transfer the customer sent to someone else or abroad (e.g. to another country) is showing pending or still processing / not complete after hours; includes asking how much longer it will stay pending. Not a transfer from the customer's own UK/other bank account into this account.
examples: How much longer do I have to wait until my transaction is complete? I transferred money to another country many hours ago and the transaction is still pending.
How long do you expect me to wait for the transfer? It finally worked out, but has been pending for a long time and it's quite urgent.

criteria.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked after too many wrong attempts; how to unblock the PIN/card.
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money into the account; receiving salary or payments from others; can I get paid into this account.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A merchant refund that was promised is not showing up in the account yet.
criteria.request_refund: Customer wants to get a refund for a purchase / how to request a refund.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reverted/returned/reversed; payment went through then was cancelled back.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (e.g. debit/credit card types) and currencies can be used for top-up or payments; is a particular card type supported.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fee for topping up by bank transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fee for topping up with a card; charged when topping up by card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up with cash or cheque; can I deposit cash or cheques.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up attempt explicitly failed, was declined, gave an error, or does not work at all.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was explicitly reverted/cancelled/returned, or the customer saw the top-up arrive and then it disappeared again.

topping_up_by_card.meaning: Topping up the account with a debit/credit card: how to do it, and problems with a card top-up such as the money being taken/gone after topping up by card.
examples: I used my card to top-up but the money is gone!

criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same transaction was charged twice / duplicate charge.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Customer was charged a fee for a transfer.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into the account / top up by bank transfer; details needed to transfer in.

transfer_not_received_by_recipient.meaning: Customer sent a transfer (e.g. within the country, to a friend, landlord or retailer) and it is not showing up / hasn't arrived at the other end / recipient hasn't received it; asks to check what happened.
examples: I made a transfer the day before yesterday within this country. It is still not showing up at all. I have double-checked and the account number is certainly right. I've actually type this multiple times. can you look into what is going on here?

transfer_timing.meaning: General questions about how long transfers take (e.g. from the US or Europe, to reach an account), or a customer waiting on 'my transfer' asking how much longer, without saying it is an outgoing transfer they sent or that it's showing pending.
examples: It's been a couple days how much longer do I have to wait for my transfer?

criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Customer is trying to verify identity but it is failing / cannot complete verification.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity; what documents are needed for identity verification.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Verifying or explaining the source of funds / where money comes from.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verification code or verification step for a card top-up; where to find the top-up verification code.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: Virtual card is not working / not accepted.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Is the card Visa or Mastercard; which card network; wanting to get a Visa card or a Mastercard specifically.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why the bank needs to verify identity; why verification is required.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM gave the wrong amount of cash / less cash than requested.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong exchange rate applied to an ATM cash withdrawal abroad.
